title: Ticket needs more information from the user
symptom: A ticket just says 'it's broken' with no details
user_description: Ticket says: 'My computer is broken. Fix it.' That is the whole ticket.

options.text: Close the ticket because it has too little detail
options.why: Leaves the user without help and looks unprofessional. Ask for what you need instead.

options.text: Make changes by guessing and see if it works
options.why: Guessing can make things worse and wastes time. Ask first.

options.text: Reply with 'please provide more information' and nothing else
options.why: Too vague. The user already gave a vague report, so a vague request produces another vague reply.

options.text: Ask a few specific, plain-language questions, such as what they were doing, the exact message, when it started and who else is affected, and ask for a screenshot
options.why: Specific, simple questions are easy to answer and give you what you need. A screenshot shows exactly what the user sees.

hints: Why is a vague request likely to get a vague answer?
How can you make them easy to answer?
real_world_tip: Limit yourself to three or four questions. Long lists put users off replying.
